svg.title: Md Tarek Islam, machine learning engineer
svg.desc: Night drive through London. The name Md Tarek Islam and the role line, machine learning engineer: recommender systems, computer vision and serverless ML, sit in a night sky above a London skyline with the London Eye, the Gherkin, Tower Bridge and the Shard. Cars, a black cab and a red double-decker bus drive along the road below, keeping left: east in the far lane, west in the near lane.
svg.text: Machine learning engineer: recommender systems, computer vision and serverless ML
